about.title: Montebello Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Montebello sees a steady flow of traffic between SR-60, Beverly Boulevard, and Whittier Boulevard, and public records show 246 injury collisions and 321 people injured in the most recent final year, with a noticeable jump in reported crashes on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. If you were hurt in one of these collisions, the days right after matter — insurance adjusters move fast, and evidence like skid marks, vehicle damage, and witness memory fades quickly. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm; we help injured Montebello residents get in touch with an independent personal injury attorney who can look at the specifics of the crash, gather what's needed, and handle communication with the insurance company. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. You don't have to sort through this alone or guess what to say to an adjuster.

whyChoose.title: What Montebello Drivers Should Know Before Talking to an Insurer

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, though claims against a government entity (like certain road defect cases) can require notice in as little as six months. Missing these windows can end your ability to recover, so it helps to talk to someone early.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash — your share of fault simply reduces the amount. An independent attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: Unlike some states, California doesn't cap non-economic damages such as pain and suffering in most car accident cases. That's one reason it's worth having someone evaluate the full picture of your losses before accepting an early settlement offer.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers often use those statements later to minimize what they owe. An independent attorney can talk to the insurer on your behalf.

items.question: Why does the Friday evening timing at SR-60 and Beverly Boulevard matter for my claim?
items.answer: Crash timing and location can affect what evidence is available, such as traffic camera footage or witness recall. Public records show reported collisions in Montebello tend to cluster on Friday evenings around 5-7 p.m., so documenting exact time and location details early can strengthen a claim.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney, and attorneys in the network work on contingency — meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.
